Add a touch of greenery and sophistication to your home. The 90cm artificial tree showcases a dense arrangement of short cedar leaves with vibrant hues and meticulous craftsmanship, offering a lifelike appearance. Crafted from premium PE material, the leaves are smell-less and non-allergenic, ensuring safe use indoors. Designed to withstand sunlight, this faux cypress tree maintains its rich green color year-round without fading. Housed in a pot weighted with built-in cement, the artificial topiary tree remains stable. Furthermore, its retro texture adds visual appeal. Unlike live plants, this maintenance-free tree requires no watering, pruning, sunlight exposure, or fertilizing, remaining lush through all seasons. Perfect for enhancing the ambiance of living rooms, studies, bedrooms, balconies, porches, offices, or stores, this realistic topiary ball tree brings a vibrant feel to any space.

- Realistic trailing Alocasia dragon scale plant with sculptural foliage.
- Combine with other artificial plants to create a fuller cascading display.
- No planter is included; the plant is supplied as a bare stem.
- Measures approximately 120 x 30 x 20cm when arranged as shown.
- Green, large-leaf artificial hanging plant for indoor displays.
- Textured, deeply veined dragon-scale leaves create a realistic look.
- The trailing form adds height and movement to shelves, ledges, hanging baskets and wall displays.
- Hard-wearing and convincingly lifelike, it stays full and colourful year-round.
- Supplied as a bare stem without a pot, ready to drape or hang.
- Allergen-free and mess-free, with no watering, feeding or light required.

## Information
Bring year-round greenery to your home or workplace with this 120cm artificial trailing Alocasia dragon scale plant. Its textured, deeply veined leaves create an exotic, sculptural look, while the trailing form adds height and movement to shelves, high ledges, hanging baskets, mantels and wall displays. Requiring no watering, feeding or light, it offers a low-maintenance alternative to a live plant and stays full and colourful throughout the year. The plant is supplied as a bare stem without a pot, ready to drape or hang. It measures approximately 120 x 30 x 20cm when arranged as shown.

springCandidate.evidence: Set of 2 Artificial Spiral Boxwood Topiary Trees - Green

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Premium quality, exceptionally lifelike and realistic.
- UV protected, suitable for both indoor & outdoor use.
- Sold as a pair (set of 2). Height: 90cm/3ft.
- Look stunning planted up into large tubs placed either side of front doors or entrances.

## Information
These classically shaped artificial boxwood spiral trees are extremely lifelike and realistic looking. From a short distance it's hard to believe they are not real. Perfect if you don't want the hassle or have the time to care for living plants. Easy and maintenance free so no need to water or prune. The trees simply look perfect all year round. Suitable for outdoor use, the foliage is UV protected to prevent the colour from fading. The trees look absolutely fantastic either side of entrances, doorways, on the balcony, outside shop fronts, offices and receptions as well as bars & restaurants. For an extra stylish look, plant the trees up into large planters or tubs. Fill the bottom with a heavy material such as sand or stones to prevent the tree from being blown over in strong winds. Then fill with a material that can be compacted such as ordinary soil up to the level you want the tree to sit in the planter. Place the tree in the middle and fill to the top and compact hard around the plastic pot and the base of the tree. The tree has a strong solid wood centre, making it robust and durable. They are supplied in a plastic pot with concrete filling to stabilize the base of the tree. Please note the trees are packed in cardboard cartons for maximum protection. The trees are lying down flat in the boxes which can cause the plastic foliage to be compressed and a little out of shape. The perfect shape can be regained by gently pulling and fluffing the foliage back into shape. These trees are sold as a pair (2 trees per carton).

## Features

## Information
Evoke feelings of a tropical climate with the Green Sago Palm Artificial Cycas Plant from Homescapes. Measuring approximately 75 cm (26), this replica palm tree is ideal as a large table centrepiece or floor ornament, and would look great both traditional dark-wood settings for exotic style, or with light interiors for a modern, natural look. products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Premium quality, exceptionally lifelike and realistic.
- UV protected, suitable for both indoor & outdoor use.
- Sold as a pair (set of 2). Height: 120cm/4ft.
- Look stunning planted up into large tubs placed either side of front doors or entrances.
- Maintenance free

## Information
These classically shaped artificial boxwood spiral trees are extremely lifelike and realistic looking. From a short distance it's hard to believe they are not real. Perfect if you don't want the hassle or have the time to care for living plants. Easy and maintenance free. The trees simply look perfect all year round. Suitable for outdoor use, the foliage is UV protected to prevent the colour from fading. The trees look absolutely fantastic either side of entrances, doorways, on the balcony, outside shop fronts, offices and receptions as well as bars & restaurants. For an extra stylish look, plant the trees up into large planters or tubs. Fill the bottom with a heavy material such as sand or stones to prevent the tree from being blown over in strong winds. Then fill with a material that can be compacted such as ordinary soil up to the level you want the tree to sit in the planter. Place the tree in the middle and fill to the top and compact hard around the plastic pot and the base of the tree. The tree has a strong solid wood centre, making it robust and durable. They are supplied in a plastic pot with concrete filling to stabilize the base of the tree. Please note the trees are packed in cardboard cartons for maximum protection. The trees are lying down flat in the boxes which can cause the plastic foliage to be compressed and a little out of shape. The perfect shape can be regained by gently pulling and fluffing the foliage back into shape. These trees are sold as a pair (2 trees per carton).

- Realistic artificial evergreen Twist Ficus tree by Leaf.

## Information
Add year-round greenery to your interior with this 110cm artificial evergreen Twist Ficus tree by Leaf. It comes potted in a plain plastic pot and is ready to display, while the separate decorative metal planter shown provides an attractive finishing touch. The plant and planter can be used together or separately, and the wired stems can be shaped to suit your preferred look. Suitable for residential and commercial settings. The plastic pot measures approximately 15cm in diameter x 13cm high. Keep away from fire.
Comes with the decorative metal planter shown. Items are separate and can be used together or on their own.

- A complete artificial flower arrangement kit with vase and stems to recreate the display shown in the product images, measuring approximately 60cm x 50cm x 50cm when arranged.

## Information
An elegant and realistic artificial spray of the Camelot Garden Rose, this stem captures the romantic charm of a classic climbing rose. It features a generous cluster of delicate blooms in various stages of life, from tightly closed buds to gracefully opened flowers, creating a natural, fresh-cut appearance. ## Features
- Entirely artificial with no need to water.
- Ideal for brightening up your home
- Botanically accurate
- Designed for indoor use
- Matching items available
- Premium 100 cm artificial Azalea plant with dark pink silk flowers, supplied fully potted for convenient indoor display.
- Arranged dimensions are approximately 100 cm high by 50 cm wide. The wired stems can be adjusted to create the desired shape and fit your space.
- Supplied fully potted in a moss-covered weighted pot measuring approximately 15 cm wide by 12 cm high.
- Place the plant inside a larger planter and cover the base with bark, gravel or soil for a more realistic display. The silk flowers are not suitable for outdoor use.
- Botanik artificial Azalea plant, model BK-7285.
- Features silk flowers and is suitable for indoor use only.
- Wired stems allow you to adjust the plants shape and positioning.
- Includes a moss-covered weighted pot for a stable, finished display.
- Premium Botanik artificial Azalea with dark pink silk flowers and a fully potted design.
- Lead time to ship: 1 day.

## Information
Bring lasting botanical style to your home with the Botanik artificial azalea. The pink flower arrangement measures approximately 100 cm high by 50 cm wide when styled, with flexible wired stems that can be adjusted to suit your space. It arrives fully potted in a moss-covered weighted pot and includes a separate copper metal planter for a polished display. Use the plant and planter together or separately as required. Made from plastic, this low-maintenance decoration can be refreshed by wiping it with a damp cloth.
Artificial Azalea plant, adorned with dark pink flowers. This luxurious addition to our premium range of artificial plants and trees comes fully potted . The wired stems allow for easy adjustment to fit your space perfectly, while the moss-covered weighted pot adds a touch of elegance. For an even more impressive display, place this stunning plant inside a larger planter and cover it with bark, gravel, or soil for a truly realistic effect. Please note that the silk flowers make this plant unsuitable for outdoor use.

- Create an eye-catching table display with this large artificial bush orchid, featuring realistic detail, dark pink flowers and an arranged size of approximately 85cm high by 70cm wide.

## Information
Bring lasting botanical style to your interior with the Botanik 150cm Giant Pink Orchid Plant. Featuring 189 Real Touch flowers, this artificial orchid offers a lifelike appearance and realistic feel without watering or ongoing plant care. The wired stems can be shaped to suit your space and create your preferred arrangement. As shown, the plant measures 150cm high by 70cm wide and 70cm deep. It comes in a durable weighted plastic pot measuring 27cm in diameter and 23cm high. For an enhanced display, place it in a decorative planter, available separately. Pack size: 1.
Our exquisite artificial bush orchid serves as a stunning centerpiece for any table. This grand flowering plant boasts large dark pink flowers and meticulous attention to detail. Standing at an impressive high and wide when displayed as depicted in our images, it features 9 leaves and 56 flowers. The intricate craftsmanship is truly remarkable. Delivered in a plastic pot , it can easily be transferred to a larger planter for an even more striking presentation.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Create a tropical feel in your home with detailed artificial palm foliage that adds greenery without watering or maintenance.
- Realistic green fronds create an attractive artificial plant display. The tree stands 50cm high when arranged as shown.
- Wired stems can be arranged to suit your space. The pot measures 11cm wide x 9cm high and has fixed, non-shedding imitation soil.
- Supplied in a plain black plastic pot with fixed imitation soil, ready to display or place inside a larger planter.
- Leaf Design UK product.
- Colour: Palm, green.
- Material: plastic.
- Pot size: 11cm wide x 9cm high.
- Weight: 1.23kg.
- Pack size: 1.

## Information
Add a tropical touch to your conservatory, bathroom, hallway or living space with this 50cm artificial palm tree. Its realistic leaf structure and green fronds bring lasting greenery without watering or regular maintenance. The wired stems can be shaped to suit your display, while the compact design makes it easy to position in smaller spaces. It comes ready to display in a plain black plastic pot measuring 11cm wide x 9cm high, topped with fixed imitation soil that will not shed. The metal planter shown in the images is for illustration only and is not included.
Our artificial palm trees have incredible attention to detail and will certainly make your home feel more tropical. These look brilliant in conservatories, bathrooms or hallways and add a splash of greenery with no need to water or maintain them. With a realistic leaf structure and beautiful green fronds this is a really attractive artificial plant. This artificial tree stands high when arranged as shown in the pictures. Stems are wired so this can be arranged to fit your space perfectly. Black plastic pot and has an imitation soil on the top of the pot (fixed and solid, will not shed). It is highly realistic with botanically accurate foliage. It comes potted in a plain plastic pot and is ready to display. You can easily put this inside a larger planter if you wish. The metal planter pictured is for illustration only and is not included.

## Features
- Each flower has 45 overlapping faux silk petals.
- The purple flowers have hints of blue and white.
- The flowers are prettily marked in the middle.
- All the faux silk pansies have a yellow stamen.
- The leaves are scalloped made from faux silk.
- Moss covers the base of the plant
- The baskets are made from real willow rattan.
- Each pansy is made from faux silk material.

## Information
Pair of rattan patio planters/baskets with bright and vibrant artificial pansies and decorative conifer/cedar topiary in the centre. Extremely realistic and life-like looking. Hard to tell they are not real from only a short distance. Dark rattan planters/baskets, size 24 x 24cm at the top and 60cm in height. Ready assembled and ready to display straightaway on your porch, patio or garden. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use (UV protected to prevent colour fading). Can stay outside in all weather conditions all year round. However, we do advise keeping them out of extremely windy areas as strong winds may blow them over. Easy and carefree alternative to real plants and flowers. No care or attention required. No time-consuming watering, feeding or pruning anymore, simply unpack, position, sit back and enjoy. They look fantastic pretty much anywhere in the garden or around the house but also great outside shop fronts, bars, restaurants and hotels as well as offices, schools and nurseries. Available with different colours: all white, white & yellow, purple & yellow, purple & white or pink & white flowers. The planters are packed in cardboard boxes for protection during shipment, this may cause the foliage to be a little compressed or out of shape on arrival. We recommend you spend a little time when you open the box to gently arranging the foliage by folding out branches, leaves and flower to a natural looking shape. To view our range of artificial products on please type \"Greenbrokers\" in the search bar. About us: We design and supply an exclusive range of top-quality artificial trees and flowers which have been made to our exact specifications to look as life-like as possible. We pride ourselves in the quality of our products and excellent customer service.

## Information
Add a cheerful focal point to your home with this 38cm artificial red cyclamen plant from Leaf Design UK. Swept-back red flowers rise above heart-shaped, silver-marbled leaves for a realistic, decorative display. Its compact size suits a kitchen windowsill, desk, shelf, bedside table, dining table or reception area. The plant requires no watering, feeding or sunlight, while its flowers and leaves retain their fresh-looking appearance without wilting or shedding petals. The wired stems can be shaped to suit your space. It arrives fully assembled in a weighted plastic pot measuring approximately 12.5cm in diameter and 11cm high. Overall dimensions are 38 x 20 x 20cm when arranged as shown. Not suitable for outdoor use.
